highlights.description: Absolute zero inside is much cooler than Intel inside

highlights.title: PSA: ChatGPT outage is blocking users from logging in or creating new accounts [U: Fixed]
highlights.description: Update, 8:54 p.m. ET: OpenAI says the issue is now fully resolved. The original story follows below. OpenAI has confirmed that users are encountering errors when trying to log in to their accounts or create new ones. Here are the details.

highlights.title: EU Welcomes Apple's App Store Changes, Epic Slams 'Junk Fees'
highlights.description: Apple yesterday updated its App Store fees in the EU to comply with the Digital Markets Act and to put an end to its ongoing conflict with the European Commission. Apple cut the Core Technology Fee and simplified its pricing structure, so apps distributed through alternative marketplaces or through the web will pay less than before. When announcing the changes, Apple said it worked in "close collaboration" with the EC, and that the updates would "resolve Apple's disagreements with the Commission

highlights.title: LeadShine's Zheng on China's Robotics Supply Chain
highlights.description: Nangle Zheng, Strategic Investment Director at LeadShine Technology, says China has shortened the development cycle for humanoid robots from years to just months. He speaks to David Ingles and Yvonne Man on "Bloomberg: The China Show." (Source: Bloomberg)

highlights.title: Unitree Sees Robots Reaching ‘Mass Market’ Within Decade
highlights.description: Humanoid robots will reach “mass market” popularity within a decade, after manufacturers solve problems that hold back their current usefulness, the founder of China’s Unitree Robotics said.

highlights.title: Samsung confirms August 27 event for the ‘newest addition to the Galaxy S26 family’
highlights.description: Samsung is teasing a new entrant to the Galaxy S26 series coming at an event on August 27, but it’s probably not going to be that exciting.

highlights.title: Thai PM Anutin’s Family Firm Eyes $1.5 Billion Data Center Bids
highlights.description: Stecon Group Pcl plans to bid for three data-center construction projects worth a combined 49.8 billion baht ($1.5 billion), betting on the sector to drive further growth as technology investment surges in Thailand.

highlights.title: China's Xynova on Developing Human-like Robot Hands
highlights.description: Alex Xia, Founder and CEO at Hangzhou-based robot hand maker Xynova, discusses innovation and industry bottlenecks. He also talks about and fundraising plans exclusively on "Bloomberg: The China Show." (Source: Bloomberg)
